row.evidence: Squarespace's Okta SSO guide lists SCIM (create, update, deactivate users) and says "This feature is for Premium and Enterprise customers only. It's not available for other plan levels".
row.notes: SCIM and SSO are Enterprise-only (plus legacy Premium platform plans, no longer sold); Enterprise is not on the pricing page and is sold through an account manager. SCIM works only through the Okta OIN app with a SCIM API key requested from Squarespace; Entra ID (OIDC) and Google (SAML) are SSO-only. Public plans are per website: Basic $19, Core $29, Plus $49, Advanced $99 per month billed annually; Basic allows up to 2 contributors. No contributor-management API.

auth.token_source: SCIM API key issued by Squarespace (contact your account manager)

operations.notes: Update user attributes is supported; the docs do not say whether Okta sends PUT or PATCH.

attributes.notes: Docs name the Okta attributes firstName and lastName; mapped here to name.givenName and name.familyName. emails is limited to one value equal to userName.

roles.how: Okta groups app_squarespace_admin and app_squarespace_editor grant Admin or Website Editor on first SSO login (SSO-protected sites).

limitations.text: SCIM is documented only for Okta; the Entra ID and Google guides cover SSO only.
SCIM API key must be requested from Squarespace; it is not self-serve.
Okta's import users feature is not supported.
Only Admin and Website Editor permissions can be granted from Okta groups.

scim.notes: SCIM is documented only for the Okta OIN app. The SCIM API key comes from the Squarespace account manager and is entered in Okta's Provisioning > Configure API Integration; no base URL or generic SCIM endpoint is published.

user_api.notes: Squarespace's developer APIs cover forms, orders, inventory, transactions and commerce; the help centre lists no contributor or organization-member API.

okta.notes: OIN app: OIDC SSO plus SCIM Create, Update, Deactivate.

entra.notes: Set up as an App registration (OIDC) in the customer's tenant; no provisioning.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin; no provisioning.

searched: https://support.squarespace.com help-centre search API: scim, single sign-on, saml, okta, contributor permissions, Squarespace Enterprise, API key, remove contributor, Premium plan, Enterprise plan
open_questions: SCIM base URL, auth scheme details, Groups support, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented.
What SCIM deactivation does to the contributor (removal vs suspension, site access) is not documented.
Whether SSO must be configured before SCIM is not stated, though SCIM setup is in the Okta SSO guide.
